items.title: James Chirillo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: he told me he never practiced so much, ever in his life, as when he was playing with the Art Tatum Trio.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know, and the lesson, I forget how much he charged me but it wasn’t much, but part of the lesson was, I mean, when I show up you’ve got to have a New York Post and either one or two quarts of Ballantyne Ale, depending on how he was feeling that day. That was Tiny. But he told me he never practiced so much, ever in his life, as when he was playing with the Art Tatum Trio.
